title: Mozartstraße, Kaiserslautern
description:
Exquisite loft with a spacious living area, a cozy dining room, a stylish bar table and a modern stainless steel kitchen including a high-quality SbS refrigerator. The loft has an inviting bedroom, an elegant hallway with a practical storage room and a luxurious bathroom/toilet with shower. Enjoy relaxing moments on the spacious balcony on the sun-drenched south side or the wonderful balcony on the north side. The property also offers a spacious garage with an electric door opener and hand-held transmitter as well as an additional parking space directly at the house. Welcome to your new dream home!

360° Tour: (hidden)

Description
Location and accessibility:

Mozartstrasse is located in the heart of Kaiserslautern and offers excellent connections to the city center.

On foot: A leisurely walk of around 5 minutes will take you to the city center.

By car: Mozartstrasse is only about 5 minutes away from the nearest motorway exit (A6).

Nature and relaxation:

If you like walking in nature, you will love the proximity to the city park. The park is a short walk from the apartment and offers green areas, benches and a pond.

For longer walks or hikes, I recommend the Palatinate Forest, which can be reached in about 10 minutes by car.

Shopping options and infrastructure:

In the immediate vicinity you will find supermarkets, bakeries, cafés and restaurants.

The nearest bus stop is just a few minutes' walk away, making it easy to use public transport.

These apartments offer an ideal combination of urban life, nature and practical accessibility. Don't hesitate to arrange a viewing appointment!

title: Karl-Marx-Straße, Kaiserslautern
description:
Modernes City-Apartment mit Balkon & Aufzug – zentral in Kaiserslautern | Ideal für Business & Langzeitaufenthalte

Willkommen in Eurem stilvollen Zuhause auf Zeit – zentral gelegen im Herzen von Kaiserslautern, nur wenige Schritte vom Hauptbahnhof entfernt. Dieses moderne POP-ART-Apartment verbindet urbanes Lebensgefühl mit durchdachtem Komfort – ideal für Geschäftsreisende, Projektmitarbeiter, Studierende oder Städtereisende.

Auf rund 40 m2 erwartet Euch ein durchdachtes Raumkonzept mit viel Licht, Stil und Funktion. Ob Ihr nur für wenige Nächte oder mehrere Wochen bleibt: Hier findet Ihr alles, um Euch sofort wie zu Hause zu fühlen.

Business-ready & komfortabel:
Das Apartment bietet ruhige Arbeitsmöglichkeiten und eine schnelle WLAN-Verbindung – ideal für mobiles Arbeiten oder längere Projekteinsätze in Kaiserslautern und Umgebung. Dank Waschmaschine, voll ausgestatteter Küche und hochwertiger Ausstattung müsst Ihr auch bei längeren Aufenthalten auf nichts verzichten.

Sonnenbalkon & entspannter Feierabend:
Startet den Tag mit einem Nespresso-Kaffee und genießt abends ein Glas Pfälzer Wein auf dem sonnigen Balkon – Euer privater Rückzugsort mitten in der Stadt.

Highlights auf einen Blick:

Top-Lage: Nur wenige Gehminuten zum Hauptbahnhof, Zentrum & Einkaufsmöglichkeiten
Voll ausgestattetes Apartment: Küche, Waschmaschine, gemütlicher Wohn-/Schlafbereich
Aufzug: Bequemer Zugang direkt bis zur Wohnungstür
Business & Langzeit geeignet: WLAN, Arbeitsplatz, alle Annehmlichkeiten für längere Aufenthalte
Ruhiger Balkon: Sonne & Entspannung mit Blick ins städtische Leben
Egal ob Ihr geschäftlich unterwegs seid, ein langfristiges Projekt betreut oder Kaiserslautern als Stadt entdecken wollt – dieses Apartment bietet Euch den idealen Mix aus Lage, Komfort und Stil.

Wir freuen uns auf Eure Anfrage und heißen Euch herzlich willkommen!

title: Wilhelm-Raabe-Straße, Kaiserslautern
description:
Move comfortably into your own space with this fully equipped apartment, located right next to the Technical University. Ideal for students, short-term tenants, and tradespeople.

Features

The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a high-rise building and is easily accessible by elevator. It includes a combined living and sleeping area, a bathroom, and a separate kitchenette (pantry kitchen with refrigerator). It is fully furnished and features a private balcony.

A shared laundry room with dryer is available in the building.
High-speed internet up to 1000 Mbit is possible, making it ideal for home office or study.
Parking spaces are available, and an underground parking spot in the building’s garage can be rented additionally.

The apartment is located about 600 m from the university (8 minutes on foot) and 200 m from the Fraunhofer Institute (3 minutes on foot). A bus stop with direct connections to the city center is just 100 m away. The main train station is approximately 1 km away, about a 15-minute walk.

There are numerous shops nearby, including Aldi, Lidl, Edeka, Netto, and Wasgau, as well as a bakery, a Sparkasse bank, and a pharmacy.

title: Stiftsplatz, Kaiserslautern
description:
Our roooms provide everything the ambitious traveller desires. Starting with highly equiped room with multimedia with the 40“ LED HDTV screen, free SKY Cinema and SKY Champions-League channels, iPhone and HDMI connections ports, over to the high speed wifi connection, luxurious beds, air conditioning and sound proof windows, and the enjoyable Espresso machine and rain shower.

The design and atmosphere are generous and of timeless modernity.
Our room service offers small and international dishes.

The Rooftop-Spa: Enjoy the sauna and relax after a hard day.
Our spa area with roof terrace offers a beautiful view over the Stiftsplatz and the city of Kaiserslautern. The spa consists of a sauna area and relaxation rooms.
After your sauna you can relax with a tea. Take a break from your work day in the calm down area on rest on a daybed with a wonderful view over the city.
Furthermore you have the possibility for a work out at our gym. Here you can carry out your training on high-quality sports equipment from Technogym®. Opening hours can be requested at reception.
